workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH are free next week (for a 30-min meeting):

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 12:00-12:30, 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against these slots and let me know which times work for all four partners.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots work for all four partners:

- Monday 09:00-10:00: Elena busy all morning until 10:00 (09:00-09:30 Contract review, 09:30-10:00 Recruiting call)
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Elena busy 13:00-14:00, David also busy 13:00-14:00
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both Elena and David busy 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday 12:00-12:30: Elena is free, but David has Quarterly planning 12:00-12:30
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David busy entire time (15:00-15:30 Partner lunch, 15:30-16:00 Busy). Elena only free 15:00-15:30.
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena has Hiring panel 10:00-10:30
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David busy the entire time

It appears there is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are free. Can you double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see if there are any other times when both are available that I might have missed? Or do we need to report this as infeasible?

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
You're right to have me double-check. I found an error in my original list - I incorrectly included Wednesday 12:00-12:30 (Priya is actually busy then with Team standup). 

The CORRECTED list of times when BOTH Priya and Marcus are free is:
- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

These are the ONLY times both are available. Since you've confirmed that Elena and David have conflicts during all of these slots, there is no 30-minute window next week when all four partners are free.

I recommend we report this task as infeasible with the reason: "No 30-minute slot exists next week when all four partners (Priya, Marcus, Elena, and David) are simultaneously available."
